question: How should liṅgas such as the rich type be proportioned by height?
premises: Liṅgas of types beginning with the rich are under consideration.
The parts must be made equal in division.
inference: One should fashion liṅgas such as the rich type with heights divided into equal parts.
uncertainties: The exact referents of āḍhyādi liṅgas depend on prior context.
plain_english: One should fashion liṅgas of the rich type and so on with their heights divided into equal parts.
